quote: mREBEL (Multilingual Relation Extraction By End-to-end Language generation)

We present mREBEL (Multilingual Relation Extraction By End-to-end Language generation), which is a multilingual relation extraction model pre-trained on SRED FM . It is a multilingual extension of the REBEL model introduced in Huguet Cabot and , which uses a seq2seq architecture to convert relations into text sequences that can be decoded by the model.
